title: Inside Atlas's prototype shop: Boston Dynamics discloses one-day build, targets one hour
source: Tech Times (citing Boston Dynamics film and Humanoids Daily)
machine_does: Boston Dynamics can now assemble one Atlas humanoid in about a day and aims for one hour by 2027
why_it_matters: Faster building is what lets humanoids move from research to factory scale.
date_checked: page metadata published 2026-10-14T23:20-04:00 (= 03:20Z Oct 15); the article says the film was published that day; not in 4-day pool

title: NEURA Robotics introduces Neuron AI, a model that gives robots touch, 3D vision, audio and memory
source: Business Wire via Yahoo Finance (NEURA press release)
machine_does: German robot maker NEURA launched Neuron AI, one model for perception, language and action that runs on five NEURA robot bodies including its humanoid
why_it_matters: A European rival to US and Chinese robot brains; shows the race is moving from hardware to the AI that drives it.
date_checked: press release timestamp Tue 13 Oct 11:29 PM PDT = 2026-10-14T06:29Z, inside window; not in pool

title: Robot maker AGIBOT nears new funding round at RMB 50 billion valuation
machine_does: AGIBOT, the Chinese humanoid maker, is closing a RMB 1-1.5 billion round at about RMB 50 billion valuation, which pushes its Hong Kong IPO past end of 2026
why_it_matters: Shows how much money is chasing humanoid robots in China and delays a major robot IPO.
date_checked: article metadata 2026-10-14T07:18:53Z; only an older IDC shipments item for AgiBot in pool, different story

title: UBTECH and FAW Volkswagen sign deal to test humanoid robots for factory logistics
machine_does: UBTECH Walker S humanoids will be tested moving parts and restocking workstations in FAW Volkswagen assembly plants after earlier trials in Qingdao
why_it_matters: A major carmaker moves humanoids from quality checks into daily logistics work.

title: Humanoid robots are being trained to stack shelves at night in a Danish grocery store
machine_does: Hive Robots is training Unitree humanoids, remote-piloted in VR to collect data, to restock shelves at a Foetex store in Lyngby after closing time
why_it_matters: Shows humanoids entering ordinary shops, and the training method (humans pilot, AI learns).
date_checked: page dated 14-Oct-2026 20:34 CGTN time; Google pubDate 12:34Z; not in pool (the Walmart robots item is different)

title: China's humanoid robot shipments hit 97% of the world as Tesla stalls
machine_does: Unitree, UBTech and AgiBot shipped about 19,100 humanoids in H1 2026, over 97% of the global total, while Tesla Optimus made a few hundred against a 5,000 target
why_it_matters: China leads humanoid production by a wide margin; Tesla is far behind its own target.
date_checked: page dated Oct 14 2026 5:45 PM IST (=12:15Z); the figures mirror IDC shipments item of 10 Oct in pool but the Tesla comparison is new; weigh as an analysis piece

title: China's NeodraDynamics unveils 13-foot hydraulic humanoid Neo1 that lifts over 1,100 lb
machine_does: Neo1 uses 39 hydraulic joints plus electric drives to lift heavy loads; shown with JD Industrial at the China International Industry Fair
why_it_matters: Heavy-duty humanoid for dangerous industrial work, a different design from the usual electric ones.

title: Intel unveils robotics AI platform uniting real-time control and AI on one chip
source: Tech Times / Chosunbiz (Intel Robotics Workshop, Seoul)
machine_does: Intel presented a chip platform for robot factories, shown at its Robotics Workshop in Seoul with a Circulus humanoid lifting boxes, with Korean partners
why_it_matters: Intel is pushing into robot brains as physical AI becomes a chip market.
date_checked: Chosunbiz metadata 2026-10-14T07:53Z, workshop held on the 14th; not in pool (only Intel foundry/Ultra items)

title: Stryker backs CMR Surgical with about $400m, with option to buy the surgical robot maker
machine_does: Stryker puts roughly $400 million into CMR Surgical, maker of the Versius soft-tissue surgical robot, and will sell it in the US
why_it_matters: A big medical-device firm bets on surgical robots as a rival to Intuitive's da Vinci.

title: ICON raises $200M Series D to scale robotic 3D-printed construction
machine_does: ICON, led by Baillie Gifford and BlackRock funds, will scale its Titan multi-story 3D printing robot system; it has built over 270 printed buildings
why_it_matters: Robots that print houses get big money at a time of housing shortage.

title: Ukraine launches nearly 500 drones at Moscow region in new large-scale attack
machine_does: Ukraine used nearly 500 strike drones on the night of 14 Oct against industrial sites and data centres (preliminary reports, impacts unconfirmed)
why_it_matters: Largest-scale drone swarm warfare against a capital region; hits Russian industry and data centres.
date_checked: article metadata 2026-10-14T17:40Z; pool has only a 12 Oct Yandex data-centre item, a different attack

title: Skapion unveils world's first native counter-swarm defence system
source: Raksha Anirveda (also Israel Defense, sUAS News, UK Defence Journal)
machine_does: Skapion, with an Iron Dome architect, launched a system to stop drone swarms and plans an autonomous live-fire test
why_it_matters: Defence against drone swarms is a growing need after mass drone attacks.
